P/N: 2298X, Dell Part# : 430-5102 *'''DW1601 / DW 1601''' • DP/N: 08V256 (QCA9005 8V256) :Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n + Bluetooth + WiGig (60GHz) :Half-Height Mini-PCI Express Card :P/N: 8V256, JN0P4 *Dell Latitude 6430u, E5440, E5540, E6430, E7240, E7440 (JN0P4) :Note: could not work on IBM/Lenovo/Thinkpad/HP Version Laptop This device would seem to use a '''USI''' MAC for the WiFi + BT radios and a '''[[Wilocity]]''' MAC for the WiGig radio. :This card is apparently used also inside ''Dell D5000 Wireless docking station'' [http://hardforum.com/showthread.php?t=1842353 ref]. Requires an external 60GHz antenna/upconverter module (containing the ''Wil6110'' 60GHz RFIC chip). *The Dell Wireless 1601 Half Mini Card supports the WiGig Spec. v1.1 and 802.11ad D6.0. :This Card is installed in the PC/notebook in order to connect to the WiGig docking station, :the [[Dell Wireless Dock D5000]], for high data volume and high quality media. *Supports WiGig Spec. v1.1 (up to 4.6 Gbps), 802.11ad D6.0 and WLAN 802.11 a/b/g/n. :WiGig security supports GCMP encryption which is based on the GCM of the AES encryption algorithm. :Includes 802.11n compliant, and fully compatible with 802.11n and 802.11a/b/g legacy device. *Communication interface: PCIe 1.1 for WiGig and WLAN; USB HCI for BT. ===Drivers=== *[http://www.dell.com/support/drivers/an/en/andhs1/DriverDetails?driverId=WHG88 WiGig Driver] *[http://www.dell.com/support/drivers/au/en/audhs1/DriverDetails?driverId=FGND9 Wi-Fi / Bluetooth Driver] *[http://www.wireless-driver.com/dell-wireless-1601-wifi-bluetooth-win8-driver-ver1000227/ On '''wireless-driver.com'''] :The ''Dell Wireless 1601 WiGig'' card enables wireless connectivity between :''Dell Latitude 6430u Ultrabook'' and [[Dell Wireless Dock D5000]].
